item.title: House Dem reveals why his party should challenge Trump on Iran as gas prices soar $1 per gallon
item.summary: Rep. Ivey pushes a Democrat-led war powers resolution that would require Trump to pull U.S. armed forces out of hostilities with Iran if passed in Congress.

item.title: NYT columnist 'torn' about rooting for Iranian regime's downfall since it would give a win to Trump, Netanyahu
item.summary: New York Times columnist Thomas Friedman said he's "torn" about rooting for the Iran regime's defeat if it helps President Donald Trump and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

item.title: Macron under fire over Iran, Hezbollah policy as Trump admin hosts Israel-Lebanon talks
item.summary: Macron faces intense criticism for demanding Lebanon's inclusion in the ceasefire while Israel accuses France of undermining its efforts against Iran and Hezbollah.

item.title: Inside teachers' union May Day 'dress rehearsal' critics warn will 'groom' students into Dem 'foot soldiers'
item.summary: A webinar by the Chicago Teachers Union and NEA allegedly pushes May Day protest activism into classrooms, prompting backlash from education experts.

item.title: Prince Harry, Meghan Markle’s Hollywood dreams hit wall as expert warns of ‘toxic brand’ stigma
item.summary: Prince Harry and Meghan Markle face growing questions about their brand as experts cite stalled deals, waning interest, and a polarizing Australia tour.

item.title: Push to oust Trump exposes cracks among Democrats on strategy, timing
item.summary: Congressional Democrats want President Donald Trump removed from office but disagree on impeachment versus the 25th Amendment, exposing cracks in their typically unified front.

item.title: Biden DOJ weaponized FACE Act against pro-life Americans, 882-report alleges
item.summary: A DOJ report alleges the Biden administration selectively prosecuted pro-life activists under the FACE Act, reviewing over 700,000 internal records.

item.title: Popular weight-loss medications linked to hidden side effects, study finds
item.summary: A new study analyzing Reddit posts found that GLP-1 users reported side effects like fatigue, chills and menstrual irregularities not seen in clinical trials.

item.title: Azzi Fudd goes No 1 in WNBA Draft to Wings, reunites with Paige Bueckers with historic $500K salary
item.summary: Azzi Fudd went first overall to the Dallas Wings in the 2026 WNBA Draft, earning a historic $500,000 rookie salary under the league's new CBA agreement.
